channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Após criticar Janja e PT, candidato desiste de cargo no Postalis
item.description: Rafael Cisne Vasconcelos, the candidate approved by Postalis for investment director and supported by the federal government, withdrew from the position after public criticisms of First Lady Janja Lula da Silva and the Workers' Party (PT) on social media were revealed. The selection process was canceled, and Postalis announced a new call will be opened in due time, following regulations and oversight by supervisory bodies.

item.title: Lula e Alcolumbre se reúnem em meio a esforços de reaproximação
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Senate President Davi Alcolumbre met for the second time this week to deepen dialogue after months of tension. The meeting, held at the Palácio da Alvorada, aims to unlock key government priorities, particularly the PEC to end the 6×1 workweek and the Public Security PEC, both awaiting Alcolumbre’s dispatch to proceed in Congress.

item.title: Imóveis, herança e empresa nas Bahamas: o patrimônio declarado por Silvia Abravanel ao TSE
item.description: Silvia Abravanel, federal deputy candidate for the PSD and daughter of Silvio Santos, declared to the TSE a net worth of 47.5 million reais, including two houses, a rural property, a residential building, an apartment, fixed-income investments, and a stake in a Bahamas-based company. Notably, 9.3 million reais of this amount pertains to pending inheritance processes tied to a legal dispute with São Paulo’s State Treasury over inheritance tax on Silvio Santos’ fortune held in tax havens.

item.title: Crusoé: Efeito Tiririca
item.description: Comedian Francisco Everardo Oliveira, known as clown Tiririca, made history in Brazilian politics in 2010 by winning 1.3 million votes for federal deputy from São Paulo for the Partido República (PR) with the slogan 'it can't get worse than this'. His strong vote count inspired other candidates from various parties to adopt similar strategies, creating what became known as the 'Tiririca Effect' in that year's election.

item.title: Com candidatura registrada, campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro tenta virar página da fraude em filiação e reduz embate com Missão
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro secured his presidential candidacy registration after the TSE restored his PL affiliation, resolving the immediate issue of his irregular filiação with the Missão party. His campaign now seeks to downplay the incident, treating it as an ongoing legal matter and avoiding direct confrontation with Renan Santos of Missão, despite mutual accusations. The tone has shifted from broad allegations against 'the system' to a cautious stance, leaving responsibility to be determined by official investigations.

item.title: Governo vê Lei da Reciprocidade como instrumento de negociação com EUA
item.description: The Brazilian government views the Economic Reciprocity Law as a negotiation tool with the United States, not an immediate retaliatory measure. The goal is to pressure Washington into returning to a dialogue based on technical and commercial criteria, after viewing U.S. tariffs as a politically motivated move tied to election mode and broader influence in Latin America. The process includes a Camex report within up to 60 days, diplomatic notification by Itamaraty, and openness to dialogue before any countermeasures are considered.

item.title: Qual a data dos debates entre candidatos a governador nas eleições de 2026?
item.description: Governor candidate debates in the 2026 Brazilian elections began on August 9 on Bandeirantes, featuring Fernando Haddad (PT) and Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) in São Paulo, marked by low ratings and backstage confusion. Additional debates have taken place or are scheduled across states, including Minas Gerais (rescheduled to August 16), with simultaneous debates in all 26 states and the Federal District set for September 29 via Globo and affiliates.

item.title: Lula evita debates e mídia tradicional e privilegia canais digitais mais alinhados ao petista
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has been avoiding traditional media interviews and signaling he will not participate in first-round presidential debates, instead opting for informal digital platforms such as the 'Não Inviabilize' podcast, 'Inteligência Ltda.', 'Meteoro Brasil', and 'Os Três Elementos', where he focuses on personal narratives and sidesteps controversial topics. This shift in communication strategy aims to cultivate a less hostile and more favorable environment for his image as the 2026 election approaches.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro defende carteira de motorista para jovens a partir dos 16 anos
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro advocated during a live stream that individuals as young as 16 should be allowed to obtain a driver's license, linking the proposal to reducing the age of criminal responsibility to 16. He argued that earlier criminal accountability should be accompanied by granting new rights to youth, such as the right to drive. However, the proposal to allow licensing at 16 is not included in his 76-page government plan, which only references supporting the reduction of the age of criminal responsibility.

item.title: Augusto Cury declara R$ 242 milhões em bens ao TSE; Júlio Delgado, vice na chapa, diz ter R$ 3,5 milhões
item.description: Augusto Cury, the Avante party's presidential candidate for 2026, declared R$242 million in assets to the TSE, including R$121 million lent to his own company. His running mate, Júlio Delgado, a former federal deputy from Minas Gerais, declared R$3.5 million in assets. Cury advocates for political reform, including a semi-presidential system and ending life tenure for STF justices.

item.title: Operação da PF que tem como alvo Cláudio Castro é mais um revés para grupo de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The Federal Police conducted operations targeting former Rio de Janeiro governor Cláudio Castro and allies over alleged fraud at the Refit refinery, involving tax evasion, marking another setback for Flávio Bolsonaro’s political group in Rio de Janeiro. The PF also investigated Marcio Canella, a former state deputy and Senate pre-candidate, after seizing a rifle from his vehicle, prompting pressure on União Brasil to withdraw support for Bolsonaro in the state. These developments are isolating Flávio Bolsonaro in his electoral stronghold, where his father historically performed strongly.

item.title: TSE suspende sistema eleitoral após filiação indevida de Flávio Bolsonaro ao Missão
item.description: The TSE suspended processing of new party affiliations in the Filia system after Flávio Bolsonaro's name appeared incorrectly linked to the Mission Party, blocking his presidential candidacy registration. The measure aims to ensure electoral system integrity while the irregularity is investigated.

item.title: Crusoé: Plano de Flávio mantém Bolsa Celular, sem cashback
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's government plan maintains the Bolsa Celular program, providing free internet for women while removing the cashback component. The proposal was introduced during a July live stream with Daniella Marques of the Republicans party and criticized by Renan Santos of the Mission party, who questioned its feasibility and focus. The initiative aims to connect Brazil but sparks debate over public spending priorities.

item.title: "Não tem a menor chance", diz Kassab sobre eleição de Flávio
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, president of the PSD and vice-presidential candidate on the ticket with Ronaldo Caiado, stated that Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) 'has no chance whatsoever' of winning the presidential election, claiming his odds are zero and that polls are biased because the candidate is being shielded during the campaign. He also accused Centrist parties of supporting Lulu instead of Caiado, arguing that Caiado is not a third way but the real alternative.

item.title: Nem vitória de Lula diminuirá chances de avanço de PEC da redução da maioridade, diz relator
item.description: The rapporteur of the PEC on reducing the age of criminal responsibility, Mendonça Filho, states that the proposal will continue advancing regardless of the outcome of the 2026 presidential election, as the majority of society and Congress supports the measure. He notes that President Lula, who opposes the PEC, and his allies have obstructed its progress for over a decade, but this will not halt the project. To legitimize the proposal, Mendonça Filho suggests a referendum in 2028, arguing that Congress should reflect the popular will.

item.title: 'Fora da bolha': os fujões de debates e as reconciliações nem tão sinceras de Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The 'Fora da Bolha' videocast examines the growing trend of leading candidates avoiding debates at the start of the 2026 election campaign, as well as the politically motivated reconciliations between Lula and Davi Alcolumbre, and between Flávio Bolsonaro and Michelle Bolsonaro, questioning their sincerity. The episode also highlights a new controversy involving Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes.

item.title: Brasil inicia processo de reciprocidade para mandar recado aos EUA
item.description: The Lula government has initiated a reciprocity process against the U.S. following the lack of negotiations with Donald Trump, aiming to pressure the United States to resume dialogue on tariffs. Announced during the 2026 election campaign, the move seeks to show Brazil will not yield to American pressures and will be used by Lula to associate Flávio Bolsonaro with a favorable stance toward Trump. The Itamaraty will notify the State Department, Commerce Department, and USTR to begin diplomatic consultations, without guaranteeing immediate implementation of the law.

item.title: Sporting x Vitória de Guimarães: onde assistir, horário e escalações
item.description: Sporting and Vitória de Guimarães face off on Friday, the 14th, at 16:15 Brasília time or 20:15 Portugal time at Estádio José Alvalade in Lisbon, for the second matchday of the 2026/27 Liga Portugal. Sporting aims for its first win after a 2-2 draw in the opener, while Vitória seeks to rebound from a 1-0 loss to Arouca. The match will be broadcast in Brazil on ESPN 4 and Disney+, and in Portugal on Sport TV 1.

item.title: Grass acusa Celina de mentir e governadora o chama de desinformado
item.description: Leandro Grass (PT) accused Governor Celina Leão (PP) of lying after she claimed the BRB bailout loan was ready for signature, stating the STF did not resolve anything in the latest hearing. Leão countered by calling Grass misinformed and said Minister Luiz Fux had ordered the agreement to continue under his supervision until final understanding. The exchange took place on X (formerly Twitter) during the DF gubernatorial campaign.

item.title: Caso Flávio e Missão: entenda o que se sabe e o que falta descobrir sobre a fraude na filiação
item.description: The fraudulent attempt to transfer Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) party affiliation to the Missão party was identified and partially executed by the Electoral Justice system, leaving him without a party to register his presidential candidacy. Although the TSE confirmed no system hacking occurred and that Flávio did not express intent to switch parties, the perpetrator remains unknown, and the case also revealed a blocked attempt to alter Lula's (PT) affiliation.

item.title: Plano de Flávio tem uma menção ao governo Bolsonaro a cada 3,5 páginas; Lula é citado seis vezes
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's government plan, submitted to the Electoral Justice, mentions his father Jair Bolsonaro's mandate 22 times — averaging one reference every 3.5 pages in the 76-page document. Lula is cited six times. The article is subscriber-only and requires registration for full access.

item.title: A passada de pano de Tereza Cristina para decisão de Flávio de escalar um homem para vice
item.description: Senator Tereza Cristina defended Flávio Bolsonaro after he selected a man as his running mate in the PL presidential ticket, explaining that he had sought women for the position — including herself — but was unable to due to time constraints. She said Flávio showed good faith in trying to include a woman, but the deadline prevented it, leading to the selection of Deputy Alfredo Gaspar. Tereza downplayed criticism, emphasizing the candidate’s effort to appeal to female voters.

item.title: Lula trata os EUA à moda Trump
item.description: Lula invoked the Reciprocity Law in response to U.S. tariff increases, adopting a confrontational stance reminiscent of Trump by politicizing the trade agenda. This move came just days before the launch of his re-election campaign in a major rally in São Bernardo, raising tensions in bilateral relations. Despite the 6,800-kilometer distance between Washington and Brasília, the White House has never felt closer to Brazil’s electoral dynamics.

item.title: O Centrão 'lulou'?
item.description: Lula laid the groundwork for his 2026 re-election by securing public support from House Speaker Hugo Motta and holding a less tense meeting with Senate President Davi Alcolumbre. Though not widely visible to voters, these moves are strategically important for consolidating congressional support and advancing his government agenda.

item.title: Centrão não está neutro, diz Kassab
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, national president of the PSD and vice-presidential candidate, stated that Centrão parties are not neutral in the 2026 presidential election, contrary to their official post-convention declarations. He claimed the Centrão is aligned with Lula (PT). The remarks were made during an event with business leaders.

item.title: Lula nomeia advogado mais votado de lista tríplice para vaga no TRE-DF
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva appointed lawyer Leonardo Campos Soares da Fonseca as a titular judge of the Regional Electoral Court of the Federal District (TRE-DF), as published in the Official Gazette on August 14. The appointment will take effect on October 19, 2026, filling the vacancy left by the end of the first term of Judge André Puppin Macedo. Leonardo was the most voted candidate in the TJDFT’s triple list, receiving 34 out of 36 votes, and previously served as prosecutor for Mato Grosso do Sul and as an advisor at the TSE.

item.title: PM: imagens não apontam "indícios de abordagem" a carro de Haddad
item.description: São Paulo's Public Security Secretariat stated that footage from 40 private cameras showed no evidence of a police approach to Fernando Haddad's (PT) vehicle, despite his claim of being pursued by a police patrol after a campaign event. The state government opened a police investigation, with Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) confirming the probe and stating the driver will be formally questioned. The incident intensified campaign tensions, with Haddad calling it intimidatory and aggressive, while Tarcísio's allies said they did not expect such a strong reaction from the PT candidate.

item.title: Lula fará comícios em BH e no RJ, após lançamento oficial da campanha
item.description: Lula will hold rallies in Belo Horizonte and Rio de Janeiro following the official launch of his presidential campaign, which will take place this Sunday at the Estádio da Vila Euclides in São Bernardo do Campo. Minas Gerais and Rio de Janeiro will be the first states to host campaign events. The article is subscriber-only and requires registration for full access.

item.title: Governo Lula refaz cálculo e estima salário mínimo de R$ 1.741 em 2027
item.description: The Lula government has revised upward its projection for the 2027 minimum wage to R$ 1,741, an increase of R$ 24 from the April estimate of R$ 1,717. The new figure represents a 7.4% rise (R$ 120) over the current minimum wage of R$ 1,621 and follows the valuation policy combining 12-month inflation through November 2026 (4.93%) and 2025 GDP growth (2.3%). The adjustment will generate an additional R$ 9.9 billion in mandatory spending for the 2027 budget, due to the indexing of benefits such as pensions and BPC to the minimum wage.

item.title: Mendonça quebra silêncio sobre caso Master e ações que podem atingir ministros do STF
item.description: Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça stated in an ITER Cast podcast interview that his role in the Master case, INSS investigation, and the Dark Horse film financing probe is to remain impartial, regardless of potential ties to President Bolsonaro or fellow justices. He stressed that society expects the Court to apply the law fairly to preserve credibility and public trust in institutions.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio celebra "sobrevivência" e vê guinada na comunicação
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) campaign feels it has overcome a period of internal crises and controversies, believing 'the worst is over' following the arrival of strategist Duda Lima, who brought greater agility and a more aggressive tone in attacks against Lula, the PT, and the STF. The team now aims to focus on weakening President Lula and promoting its platform, with official campaign advertising set to begin on Sunday (August 16).

item.title: Cármen Lúcia participa de evento gratuito da BBC em SP sobre desinformação nesta sexta-feira
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Cármen Lúcia participates in a free BBC event in São Paulo on disinformation, focusing on democracy, electoral integrity, and gender-based political violence. The 'Trust is Earned' forum brings together officials, journalists, and experts to discuss disinformation challenges in Brazil and globally, including AI impacts and online abuse networks.

item.title: TSE suspende sistema de filiação após caso Flávio
item.description: The president of the TSE, Kassio Nunes Marques, ordered the temporary suspension of the Party Affiliation System (FILIA) after presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) encountered issues registering his candidacy due to an erroneous affiliation with the Missão party in the TSE system. The measure aims to correct inconsistencies and prevent further disruptions in the electoral process.

item.title: Vídeo: Mansão que fez patrimônio de Flávio disparar fica em terreno de 2.400 m² e foi quitada 27 anos antes do previsto
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro declared a net worth of R$ 8,18 million to the TSE, highlighted by a Brasília mansion valued at R$ 6.2 million on a 2,400 m² plot in Lago Sul. The property, financed over 30 years, was paid off in 2024 — 27 years ahead of schedule — raising doubts about whether his declared income could support such payments. His wealth has increased by 211% since 2018, when he declared R$ 1.73 million, driven by the sale of a Rio de Janeiro property and a chocolate franchise.

item.title: Governo Lula eleva previsão de salário mínimo para R$ 1.741 em 2027
item.description: The Lula government has raised its projection for the minimum wage to R$1,741 in 2027, an increase of R$24 from the previous estimate of R$1,717 made in April. The update reflects revised projections for inflation and economic growth.

item.title: Lula vai priorizar entrevistas a podcasts no primeiro turno
item.description: President Lula will prioritize podcast and videocast interviews during the first round of the 2026 elections to connect with Generation Z, presenting a more human and relatable image. The strategy, led by PT Communications Secretary Éden Valadares, aims to humanize the candidate through light, intimate formats, as seen in recent appearances on Inteligência Ltda., Meteoro Brasil, 'Não Inviabilize' and 'As Cunhãs'.

item.title: Motta adia votação do reajuste do Simples Nacional para depois das eleições
item.description: House Speaker Hugo Motta postponed the vote on PLP 108/2021, which adjusts the Simples Nacional tax brackets, until after the 2026 elections due to resistance from the Ministry of Planning and the federal government to the bill’s broader version. The delay aims to allow negotiations to include anti-'pejotization' measures and align the text with executive demands, while analysts note that a narrower version limited to MEIs would likely have already passed.

item.title: Veja Essa: Tamara Klink, Kássio Nunes Marques e Deborah Secco
item.description: The excerpt includes quotes from Tamara Klink, writer and sailor, who laments book waste and stresses the importance of reading; from Ignácio de Loyola Brandão, 90, recently operated for cataracts, reflecting on his writing after regaining vision; from Kassio Nunes Marques, STF minister and TSE president, warning that distrust in ballots drives voters away; and from Deborah Secco, actress, identifying with impostor syndrome. No direct mention of 2026 election candidates is made.

item.title: Jogos de hoje, sexta, 14 de agosto: onde assistir futebol ao vivo e horários
item.description: On Friday, August 14, 2026, football matches took place in Brazil and abroad, including Série B and Brasileirão Femenino fixtures, as well as games in Saudi Arabia, Turkey, England and Portugal. Highlights include Sporting vs Vitória de Guimarães at 16:15 (ESPN 4 and Disney+), Al-Hilal vs Al-Faisaly at 15:00 (GOAT and Xsports), and Atlético-MG vs Grêmio in the women's league at 21:00 (TV Brasil).

item.title: Eleições dramáticas
item.description: Brazil's 2026 presidential election is marked by high rejection of leading candidates, intense polarization, and institutional disputes, with voters often deciding by exclusion rather than endorsement. Flávio Bolsonaro runs under the shadow of his imprisoned and ineligible father, while Lula faces succession challenges and weak state-level alliances. The situation is worsened by inter-branch tensions, scandals affecting all three branches of government, and amplified influence of AI-driven social media, making the outcome uncertain and future governability a major concern.

item.title: SobeDesce: de Gemini a Anthony Garotinho
item.description: Google Gemini reached 1 billion monthly users, intensifying the AI leadership race with OpenAI's ChatGPT, which hit the same milestone in June. American surfer Kelly Slater, 54, defeated Brazilian Gabriel Medina in Teahupoo, while Tropa de Elite 2 was ranked 66th among the best film sequels of all time by IndieWire. Former Rio governor Anthony Garotinho was declared ineligible by Rio's Justice Court, removing him from this year's gubernatorial race, though he announced plans to appeal to the TSE.

item.title: Renovação em xeque: os fatores que dificultam mudanças no Legislativo
item.description: Reelection rates for Brazilian legislators are projected to reach record highs in 2026, with nearly 90% of deputies and 64.8% of senators seeking re-election, driven by unprecedented growth in parliamentary amendments (over R$ 61 billion) and electoral fund distribution favoring established parties. This concentration of resources and power entrenches incumbents, severely limiting opportunities for new entrants and reducing legislative renewal.

item.title: Lula acena a centrais e propõe volta da assistência sindical em demissões
item.description: President Lula proposes adjustments to labor legislation to guarantee the return of union assistance in the homologation of work contract terminations, as outlined in his government plan filed with the Electoral Justice. The initiative aims to strengthen worker protections during dismissals and reinforce the role of trade union centers.

item.title: Em busca do 4º mandato, Lula aumenta participação no bastidor da campanha
item.description: President Lula is closely monitoring the organization of his campaign launch event for a fourth term, scheduled for Sunday at the Primeiro de Maio stadium in São Bernardo do Campo. The event, located in the historic birthplace of the PT and Brazilian unionism, will revisit his entire political trajectory. The initiative aims to strengthen his ties with the party’s working-class roots and historical base.

item.title: Faixa 'antifascista' é estendida na USP antes de evento com Renan Santos
item.description: UNE and USP Law School students hung a banner reading 'University Antifascist Territory' at the entrance of Largo São Francisco, in protest three days before Renan Santos of Missão launches his pre-candidacy event. The demonstration was a political response to the scheduled event on Sunday.

item.title: O que explica a preferência de Lula por podcasts em vez de debates e sabatinas eleitorais
item.description: Lula has avoided participating in traditional media-hosted electoral debates and sabatinas, choosing instead to give interviews on podcasts and YouTube channels with large audiences. Since late July, he has made three appearances in this format, with another scheduled for Friday morning. This approach indicates a preference for controlled, less confrontational environments to deliver his message.

item.title: Lula planeja comício em estádio no Rio de Janeiro
item.description: President Lula plans to hold a rally at the Moça Bonita stadium in Rio de Janeiro on August 22, a Saturday, as part of his re-election campaign. The event is expected to feature former mayor Eduardo Paes (PSD), running for Rio governor, and deputies Pedro Paulo (PSD) and Benedita da Silva (PT), who are running for Senate seats. The day before, Lula will travel to Minas Gerais to support Patrus Ananias (PT) in his gubernatorial campaign.

item.title: Plano de Flávio repete ideias de Bolsonaro, mas radicaliza com STF e segurança
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro’s government plan follows the conservative and liberal line of former President Jair Bolsonaro but radicalizes proposals on security and judiciary. It includes 500,000 prison slots, five Bukele-style penitentiaries, chemical castration for rapists, reducing the age of criminal responsibility, and reforming the STF to limit monocratic decisions, while maintaining continuity with the 2019–2022 government as a reference.

item.title: Eleições 2026: partidos entram na reta final para registrar candidatos
item.description: Political parties, federations, and coalitions must register their candidates for the 2026 general elections by Saturday, August 15 at 7 p.m., marking the end of the pre-campaign period. Starting Sunday, August 16, electoral propaganda will be permitted, including online, allowing candidates to solicit votes without risk of legal penalty. Major presidential candidates such as Lula (PT), Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), Renan Santos (Missão), Romeu Zema (NOVO), and Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) have scheduled campaign launches in various cities across Brazil.

item.title: A quem interessa levantar suspeitas sobre o processo eleitoral?
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro blamed the electoral system for failing to register his government program with the TSE due to an alleged affiliation with the 'Missão' party instead of the PL, echoing his father’s rhetoric about destroying 'the system'. The article argues his only political advantage is being Jair Bolsonaro’s son, as he would otherwise trail in polls against Lula, and predicts his political decline after 2026, including loss of special jurisdiction and a potential inheritance conflict with his stepmother.
